---
title: "Bootstrap Lifecycle"
---

Use this page as the routing contract for what `repo-familiar` commands own, what stays user-owned, and which step comes next. Keep task-specific walkthroughs in the linked pages rather than duplicating them here.

## New Repository Path

1. Discover templates, harnesses, skills, and profile families with `list-*` commands before selecting defaults.
2. Preview generation with `generate --dry-run` when checking a new flag combination or template output.
3. Run `generate` only after the preview matches the intended Downstream Repository shape.
4. After generation, use `check` to compare vendored generated assets against `.repo-familiar/bootstrap.yml`.

Detailed walkthroughs live in [Usage](./usage.qmd) and [Generator](./generator.qmd).

## Existing Repository Path

1. Start with `advise` to choose stages, profile families, skills, and asset groups.
2. Run `audit` before any write, then `resolve-conflicts` when user-owned files need manual review.
3. Preview `bootstrap-existing` or the narrowest `add-*` command first.
4. Re-run the same command with `--apply` only after the preview matches the intended additive change.
5. Use `check` and `diff-upstream-candidate` for read-only maintenance. Use `upgrade --asset-group skills --preview` before the explicit skills-only apply step.

The first write-capable refresh slice applies only unchanged vendored skills and missing skill support files. Docs, profile, and template strategies remain preview-only; the broader design lives in [Plan Metadata v2 and preview-first refresh](./adr/0010-metadata-v2-preview-first-refresh.md).

Detailed walkthroughs live in [Existing Repositories](./existing-repos.qmd) and [Pre-Bootstrap Checklist](./pre-bootstrap.qmd).

## Reference Source Maintenance Path

1. Treat this repository as the Reference Source for docs, templates, registries, and command behavior.
2. Use `check-skill-sources` before manually refreshing vendored skills from recorded upstream URLs.
3. Use `diff-upstream-candidate` in a Downstream Repository before copying generated-asset changes back into the Reference Source.
4. When an intentional Reference Source dogfood change modifies an asset recorded in `.repo-familiar/bootstrap.yml`, update its selected options and checksum in the same change.
5. Keep this page short: update the routing contract here, and move longer examples or rationale into the linked command pages.

## Command Safety

| Path | Command or family | Writes files? | Safe use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Any | `list-*` commands | No | Discover templates, harnesses, skills, and profile families before selecting them. |
| New repository | `generate` | Yes | Creates a Downstream Repository; use `--dry-run` first and `--force` only for known generated output. |
| Existing repository | `advise`, `audit`, `resolve-conflicts` | No | Read-only planning and conflict review before any bootstrap write. |
| Existing repository | `bootstrap-existing`, `add-docs`, `add-model`, `add-tool`, `add-memory`, `add-prompts`, `add-safety`, `add-privacy`, `add-public-interest`, `add-repomap`, `add-sandbox`, `add-secrets`, `add-design`, `add-worktree`, `add-skill` | Only with `--apply` | Preview first; writes only selected generated assets when the apply step is chosen deliberately. |
| Maintenance | `check`, `diff-upstream-candidate`, `check-skill-sources` | No | Drift checks and upstream review remain read-only. |
| Skills refresh | `upgrade --asset-group skills --preview`, then `--apply` | Only with `--apply` | Requires a clean Git worktree by default; replaces only unchanged vendored skills, adds missing support files, records current Reference Source provenance, and updates skill-source/bootstrap metadata. Modified and removed-reference skills stay untouched. |

## Contract Ownership

| Surface | Owned by | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Reference Source docs, templates, profile registries, and command behavior | `repo-familiar` | Defines reusable Agentic Engineering Defaults for generated or bootstrapped repositories. |
| Downstream Repository files outside generated surfaces | Downstream maintainers | User-owned changes stay authoritative; bootstrap commands should not overwrite them by default. |
| Vendored Generated Assets such as `.agents/*.yml`, vendored skills, `AGENTS.md`, docs scaffold, and `plan.md` | Shared: generated by `repo-familiar`, then edited downstream | Delivered as copies, not live links; drift is expected and reviewed explicitly. |
| `.repo-familiar/bootstrap.yml` | `repo-familiar` metadata contract | Records provenance, selected options, and generated assets so checks and future upgrade previews can reason about the repository. |
| Machine-level harness config such as `~/.paseo`, global OpenCode config, shell PATH, MCP user config, and secret stores | User or team workstation owners | Must stay outside generated repository assets; `repo-familiar` may document these dependencies but must not write them. |
| Refresh or upgrade application | Explicit scoped workflow | Skills have a preview-first apply path. Other asset groups remain preview-only; there is no live sync or background refresh contract. |

## Profile Family Selection Matrix

| Metadata key | Inspect with | Select with | Targeted add | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model_profiles` | `list-model-profiles` | `--model-profile` | `add-model` | Writes `.agents/models.yml`; metadata records selected names only. |
| `tool_profiles` | `list-tool-profiles` | `--tool-profile` | `add-tool` | `add-tool` also accepts `--tool` for one-off adds; writes `.agents/tools.yml`, but setup and verification stay guidance rather than installer behavior. |
| `memory_profiles` | `list-memory-profiles` | `--memory-profile` | `add-memory` | Writes `.agents/memory.yml`; memory backends stay external and non-secret. |
| `prompt_profiles` | `list-prompt-profiles` | `--prompt-profile` | `add-prompts` | Writes `.agents/prompts.yml`; use for prompt migration and eval guidance. |
| `safety_profiles` | `list-safety-profiles` | `--safety-profile` | `add-safety` | Writes `.agents/safety.yml`; keep sensitive fixtures sanitized. |
| `privacy_profiles` | `list-privacy-profiles` | `--privacy-profile` | `add-privacy` | Writes `.agents/privacy.yml`; keep private data out of committed assets. |
| `public_interest_profiles` | `list-public-interest-profiles` | `--public-interest-profile` | `add-public-interest` | Writes `.agents/public-interest.yml`; use for civic, education, or child-facing work. |
| `repomap_profiles` | `list-repomap-profiles` | `--repomap-profile` | `add-repomap` | Writes `.agents/repomap.yml`; use `semantic-routing-map` for a project-owned routing map or `hamilton-dag` for DAG guidance. |
| `sandbox_profiles` | `list-sandbox-profiles` | `--sandbox-profile` | `add-sandbox` | Writes `.agents/sandbox.yml`; sandbox tooling stays user-installed. |
| `secrets_profiles` | `list-secrets-profiles` | `--secrets-profile` | `add-secrets` | Writes `.agents/secrets.yml` and, for some profiles, safe scaffolding such as `.env.example`; use `--sops-age-recipient` when the selected profile is `sops-age` and SOPS scaffolding should be generated. |
| `design_profiles` | `list-design-profiles` | `--design-profile` | `add-design` | Writes `.agents/design.yml`; use for design critique or accessibility guidance. |
| `worktree_profiles` | `list-worktree-profiles` | `--worktree-profile` | `add-worktree` | Writes `.agents/worktrees.yml`; worktree orchestration config remains repository guidance only. |

## Maintainer Guardrail

This page is the canonical lifecycle routing summary, not the full walkthrough. Keep longer examples in the linked docs above. When command names or profile-family selectors change, update this page and keep `tests/test_docs.py` green so lifecycle tables stay aligned with the CLI contract. Keep Metadata v2 rationale in [Plan Metadata v2 and preview-first refresh](./adr/0010-metadata-v2-preview-first-refresh.md) rather than duplicating the full future-refresh design here.

For task-specific walkthroughs, see [Usage](./usage.qmd), [Generator](./generator.qmd), [Existing Repositories](./existing-repos.qmd), and [Pre-Bootstrap Checklist](./pre-bootstrap.qmd).
